description: Get one Algerian wilaya by its two-digit code, for example 16 for Alger: its names, capital, region, population and the details of its local CNRC (trade register) and CASNOS (social security of the self-employed) offices. For Tunisia (country TN) pass the governorate code, for example 11 for Tunis: its ISO 3166-2 code, national statistics (INS) code, names in the three languages and chief town. For Morocco (country MA) pass the region code, for example 06 for Casablanca-Settat: its ISO 3166-2 code, names in the three languages and chief town. Returns an error when the code is unknown. Use list_wilayas to see the codes. Tunisia and Morocco need an API key.

code.description: Wilaya code, two digits, for example 16 for Alger or 31 for Oran. For Tunisia (country TN) it is the governorate code, two digits, the number of its ISO 3166-2 code, for example 11 for Tunis (TN-11); TN-11 is accepted too. For Morocco (country MA) it is the region code, two digits, the number of its ISO 3166-2 code, for example 06 for Casablanca-Settat (MA-06); MA-06 is accepted too. Find codes with list_wilayas.

country.description: Country of the data, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any letter case: DZ for Algeria, the default, TN for Tunisia or MA for Morocco. Only live countries answer: list_countries shows them and their datasets. Any other country, or a dataset the country does not have (for example the activity nomenclature for Morocco), returns country_not_available. Without an API key only DZ answers: TN and MA return key_required.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).

name: get_wilaya
title: Get a wilaya or governorate
